name: all-but-the-uprights
why: Negation in the query form. Eight of the block's twelve edges are rounded at 1 mm and the four uprights are left sharp, which is what the 14 faces say: the box's own 6 plus one round per treated edge, where rounding all twelve would give 6 + 12 + 8 corner patches. The volume is the kernel's, 8000 mm³ less the 51.7 the eight rounds take. `.expect({ count: 8 })` fails the build if the negation ever stops taking the four uprights out, which is the defect this case exists for — a selector that silently matched twelve would round the part into a different shape and every other number here would still look reasonable. docs/COIN_HOLDER_REVIEW.md, L2.
